builder_guide_steps.text: A quick tour of the essentials. Start enter your Popup name!
Click an element in the ribbon to ADD it to the canvas.
Drag a Element to move it and use its corner bottom handles to resize it. Elements will snap to the guides, and the arrow keys nudge the selected layer.
